files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of every file you modified or created.

summary.description: What you changed and why, 3-8 sentences.

tests_run.description: Number of tests collected in your final `pytest -q` run (0 if you did not run pytest).

tests_passed.description: Number of tests that passed in that final run.

confidence.description: Your confidence the migration is complete and correct.

reviewer_responses.description: One entry per numbered reviewer finding in the prompt; [] when the prompt lists none.

finding.description: The finding's number in the prompt.

detail.description: changed: what you changed (file, function). justified: why no change is right, citing the DriftSpec or changelog.
